title: US and Japan to establish a Japanese facility for joint missile production

blocks.text: CEBU, Philippines — The United States and Japan have agreed to establish a Japanese facility for the joint production of advanced medium-range air-to-air missiles, the Japanese defense chief said late Wednesday. It is the latest move by the allies, which have repeatedly expressed alarm over China’s growing assertiveness in Asia. Japanese Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi […]...
